cases.sentence: Было ко мне ______ Господне. Иди и провозгласи во всеуслышание в Иерусалиме.
cases.translation: The word of Yahweh came to me, saying, Go and proclaim in Jerusalem.
cases.explain: The noun is the subject of the verb 'было' (came), requiring the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Я вспоминаю о преданности твоей юности, когда ты любила меня как невеста, и шла за мной по _________.
cases.translation: I remember for you the kindness of your youth, when you loved me as a bride and went after me through the wilderness.
cases.explain: The preposition 'по' (through) when indicating movement through a place requires the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Израиль был святыней Господа, был первым плодом его жатвы. Все, кто его поедал, осуждались, их постигала ___, возвещает Господь.
cases.translation: Israel was holy to Yahweh, the first fruits of his harvest. All who devoured him were held guilty; evil came upon them.
cases.explain: The noun is the subject of the verb 'постигала' (came upon), requiring the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Что за зло нашли во мне ваши ______?, что так отдалились от меня?
cases.translation: What unrighteousness have your fathers found in me, that they have gone far from me?
cases.explain: The noun is the subject of the implied verb 'нашли' (found), requiring the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Они поклонялись ничтожным _______ и сами стали ничтожными.
cases.translation: They worshiped worthless idols and became worthless themselves.
cases.explain: The verb 'поклонялись' (worshiped) requires the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Я привел вас в плодородную _______, чтобы вы ели ее плоды и пользовались ее благами».
cases.translation: I brought you into a plentiful land to eat its fruit and its goodness.
cases.explain: The verb 'привел' (brought) requires the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Два греха совершил мой народ: оставил меня, источник живой _______, и вытесал себе водоемы.
cases.translation: My people have committed two evils: they have forsaken me, the spring of living waters, and cut out cisterns for themselves.
cases.explain: The noun 'вода' in the genitive follows the noun 'источник' (source) in the possessive construction.

cases.sentence: Посмотри, как вела ты себя в долине, подумай о том, что сделала. Ты — норовистая верблюдица, мечущаяся из стороны в сторону, дикая ослица, выросшая в _________.
cases.translation: You are a wild donkey used to the wilderness.
cases.explain: The preposition 'в' (in) when indicating location requires the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Я вспоминаю о преданности твоей юности, когда ты любила меня как невеста, и шла за мной по пустыне, по незасеянной земле.
reading.question: What does God remember about Israel's past?
options: The faithfulness and love of her youth, when she followed him through the wilderness
The idolatry and rebellion of the people
The wars and victories against the nations
The building of the great temple
reading.correct: The faithfulness and love of her youth, when she followed him through the wilderness
reading.explain: God says 'Я вспоминаю о преданности твоей юности, когда ты любила меня как невеста, и шла за мной по пустыне' — I remember your youthful devotion, when you loved me as a bride and followed me through the wilderness.

reading.ru: Израиль был святыней Господа, был первым плодом его жатвы. Все, кто его поедал, осуждались, их постигала беда, возвещает Господь.
reading.question: What is Israel's status, and what happens to those who harm Israel?
options: Israel is holy to Yahweh, his first fruits of harvest; all who devour him are guilty and evil comes upon them
Israel is a servant of the nations with no special status
Israel belongs to the idols of the earth
reading.correct: Israel is holy to Yahweh, his first fruits of harvest; all who devour him are guilty and evil comes upon them
reading.explain: The text states 'Израиль был святыней Господа, был первым плодом его жатвы. Все, кто его поедал, осуждались' — Israel was holy to Yahweh, the first fruits of his harvest; all who devoured him were held guilty.

reading.ru: Они не спрашивали, где Господь, который вывел нас из Египта, провел нас сквозь безлюдный край.
reading.question: What did Israel fail to ask, and who led them out of Egypt?
options: They did not ask where the Lord was, who brought them out of Egypt and led them through the wilderness
They asked who would lead them to Canaan
They questioned which gods were greatest
They wondered why God abandoned them so quickly
reading.correct: They did not ask where the Lord was, who brought them out of Egypt and led them through the wilderness
reading.explain: The passage says 'Они не спрашивали, где Господь, который вывел нас из Египта' — They didn't ask, Where is Yahweh who brought us up out of Egypt.

reading.ru: Я привел вас в плодородную землю, чтобы вы ели ее плоды и пользовались ее благами». Но вы пришли и осквернили мою землю, и сделали мой удел мерзостью.
reading.question: What did God do for Israel, and what did Israel do in return?
options: God brought them to a fertile land to enjoy its fruit and blessings, but they defiled the land and made God's inheritance an abomination
God gave them gold and silver, and they used them wisely
God protected them from all enemies, and they remained faithful
God established a great kingdom, and they expanded it
reading.correct: God brought them to a fertile land to enjoy its fruit and blessings, but they defiled the land and made God's inheritance an abomination
reading.explain: The passage contrasts God's provision: 'Я привел вас в плодородную землю' with Israel's response: 'Но вы пришли и осквернили мою землю' — I brought you to a fertile land, but you defiled my land.

reading.ru: Два греха совершил мой народ: оставил меня, источник живой воды, и вытесал себе водоемы, разбитые водоемы, которые не могут хранить воду.
reading.question: What are the two evils that God's people committed?
options: They forsook God, the spring of living waters, and dug out broken cisterns that cannot hold water
They built temples to false gods and sacrificed their firstborn
They fought against each other and divided the kingdom
They forgot the Sabbath and the law of Moses
reading.correct: They forsook God, the spring of living waters, and dug out broken cisterns that cannot hold water
reading.explain: The text states the two evils: 'оставил меня, источник живой воды, и вытесал себе водоемы, разбитые водоемы, которые не могут хранить воду' — forsook me, the spring of living waters, and cut out cisterns: broken cisterns that can't hold water.

reading.ru: Как ты можешь говорить, я не осквернилась, я не ходила вслед Баалом? Посмотри, как вела ты себя в долине, подумай о том, что сделала.
reading.question: What does Israel deny, and what does God tell her to do?
options: Israel denies being defiled and following Baal; God tells her to see and remember what she has done
Israel claims she has never sinned and needs no forgiveness
Israel says she will always remain faithful to God
Israel argues she should be rewarded for her faithfulness
reading.correct: Israel denies being defiled and following Baal; God tells her to see and remember what she has done
reading.explain: The passage shows Israel's denial: 'я не осквернилась, я не ходила вслед Баалом?' and God's response: 'Посмотри, как вела ты себя в долине' — How can you say you are not defiled? See your way in the valley.
